scope: items 1 through 15 of the supplied issue list

items.finding: The flat stream carries two Z_3 shares and no token contains x_j; the semantic stream supplies x directly. The inter-round commitment-plus-cut lower bound and semantic O(log m) cut upper bound use one family-relative code.
B_rel, B_self, and G are separately defined and never cross-compared; only the zero-failure family-relative upper bound is claimed tight.
The cut budget is the literal sum of control, store, window, parameter, and IR restart serializations; Q and V are explicit projections and no theorem substitutes them for the total.
Sparse parameters encode only nonzero symbol IDs, coefficients, the rational-pi numerator/denominator, and separately charged addresses.
The growing-width self-delimiting codec charges opcode, arity, qubit addresses, Pauli support, parameter IDs/payloads, and delimiter; fixed-width and growing-width regimes are separate.
A no-wrap K_epsilon-ary packing has K_epsilon=Theta(1/epsilon), separation at least 4 epsilon, and randomized output lower bound Omega(m log(1/epsilon)).
The model permits random-access RAM/DAG/cache/hash state and dynamic passes, charges the random tape/cursor, and proves randomized bounds by Fano/conditional Fano.
A memory-capped hybrid is constructed for every beta and matches the deterministic family-relative lower envelope to leading order; no self-contained or gate-count matching claim is made.
The manuscript proves d_proj <= d_diamond <= 2 d_proj for the unnormalized convention and states the explicit normalized inequalities and halved threshold.
Kraft's inequality gives the deterministic binary worst-case bound B_out >= m rather than m-1.
All ten rational angles and single-term orders, their LCM, a minimality state of order 131040, exact integer output, verifier, and SHA256 manifest are present and pass byte-for-byte verification.
The method is explicitly restricted to supported contiguous Pauli/phase/preset patterns; it disclaims general DAG maximality and general linear-time complexity.
The exact CNOT-RZ domain, modulo-2pi rule, global phase, unsupported status, soundness proof, 20 mutation cases, and dense cross-checks are explicit and verified.

The tracer records all requested fields after every input update. All 1320 event/final checks restart from serialized state only; 24 projected summaries generate the measured B_com versus B_cross curve.

All methods share epsilon_synth=1e-3 with sum_i epsilon_i within budget; actual checked staq synthesis and an explicit QRE report logical T, physical qubits, cycles, factories, runtime, and spacetime volume.
